description: ISO New England generation by fuel category in MW — natural gas, nuclear, hydro, wind, solar, refuse, wood, coal, oil, landfill gas and net interchange with neighbouring grids — with the marginal-fuel flag ISO-NE publishes alongside it. Use for "what is New England burning right now", "ISO-NE renewable share", "how much gas is New England on". Requires an API key.

_apiKey.description: ISO Express credential as "username:password" or its base64. Free account at https://www.iso-ne.com/participate/applications-status-changes/.

date.description: Day to fetch as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the current interval.
